scope: Cached128ms waveform-only modal-fit diagnostic; original TRAIN only; no warning policy or neural training

selection.ordinary_stage: Only if all predeclared critical-stage checks pass

model: Per-channel offset + exp(alpha_mid*tau +0.5*alpha_slope*tau^2)*(c*cos(2*pi*(frequency_mid*tau+0.5*frequency_slope*tau^2))+d*sin(...)); shared growth/frequency, channel-specific linear coefficients; tau centered on measured window
comparison: Archived LS-ESPRIT nearest-end-frequency and full-bank matching evaluation
measurement: Reuse all original leading51 calibration, cap50, fixed noise floor and recorded noise draws; only logical128 samples enter fits; Float32 calibrated measurements promoted to Float64 for fitting
initialization: Measured aggregate Hann-windowed demeaned FFT power,16x zero padding, peak between1Hz and Nyquist-1Hz; zero initial growth; time-varying fit warm-starts from the stationary waveform fit with both slopes zero; no reference poles or labels in fitter arguments

solver.method: scipy.optimize.least_squares trf; exact per-iterate linear least squares, rank checked
solver.frequency_limits_hz: 1 to Nyquist-1; slope bounds tightened to retain valid endpoint frequencies
solver.sign: Both positive and negative growth allowed; no stability clamp

pass_checks.all48_end_poles_match: Frequency<=5% relative error; alpha absolute error<=max(1/s,10% abs(reference alpha))
pass_checks.ramping_alpha_mae: Lower than both stationary single-mode fit and archived nearest-frequency LS-ESPRIT separately for clean and iid1

hypotheses: Stationarity mismatch: time-varying fit improves end-pole accuracy relative to both stationary comparators
Changing mode shapes/coupling: even a good single-mode chirp waveform fit can retain wrong physical end growth
Noise/derivative identifiability: slope parameters can degrade stationary/noisy accuracy despite better reconstruction
limitations: Four repeatedly inspected original TRAIN designs and one paired noise draw; not blind confirmation
Critical-only initialization is a diagnostic positive control, not a monitor input
Single-mode envelope growth need not equal instantaneous eigenvalue growth under changing modal shapes
No real-time deadline, gap confidence, noise-only availability or warning calibration claim
